prompt: Which of these is the worst-case time complexity of Bubble Sort?
explanation: Bubble Sort compares/swaps adjacent pairs across up to n passes, giving O(n²) in the worst case.

prompt: Give the best-case time complexity of Bubble Sort with an early-exit optimization (input already sorted).
explanation: If no swaps occur in a pass, the array is already sorted and the algorithm can exit after one O(n) pass.

prompt: Run Bubble Sort on [5, 3, 8, 1]. Give the final sorted array as JSON, e.g. [1,3,5,8].
explanation: Bubble Sort repeatedly bubbles the largest remaining element to the end until the array is sorted ascending.
